prompt: how to change a flat tire

plan.title: How to Change a Flat Tire Safely
plan.description: Learn the key steps to change a flat tire: park safely, loosen the nuts, jack up the car, and swap the wheel. A quick guide for any driver.

beats.narration: A flat tire doesn't have to ruin your day. Park on flat, firm ground, turn on your hazards, and set the parking brake.

props.text: A flat tire is fixable in minutes.

beats.narration: Loosen the lug nuts first, while the wheel is on the ground. Then jack up the car and remove the nuts.
Swap on the spare, tighten the nuts by hand, lower the car, then tighten them again firmly. You're back on the road.
